text: After one month, the Earth is no longer simply cold.
The lake beside this village has frozen over. Ice floats, so it seals the water underneath like a lid.
There is no light here anymore. The power went out weeks ago.
The church clock still keeps time.
But no one is outside to hear it.
Out here, the air is so cold that it hurts to breathe.
The stars would be brighter than you have ever seen them.
No sunlight. No moonlight. No city glow. Nothing left to hide them.
Earth would no longer be a world of light.
And this would only be the beginning.
